thread:
Jordan: heads-up — last night's usage ingestion for eu-west dropped ~20% during 03:00-04:00 UTC. The smoothing step in the capacity projection job is now undercounting burst headroom. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/ingest/forecasting-overview
Sara: saw that alert, thx. Do we know if it was a producer gap or consumer lag?
Liam: consumer lag. Kafka consumer group `usage-aggregator-v2` showed sustained 30k lag on partition 7. Logs show repeated `TimeoutException` to the schema-registry endpoint.
Aisha: ingest-bot reported a retry storm then backoff, which explains the dip in raw events.
ingest-bot: JOB usage-ingest-eu-west-2026-03-18 failed -> backoff triggered (503 to schema-registry) 03:21 UTC. retried 18 times, last status: degraded. link: https://ci.redwood.net/jobs/usage-ingest-eu-west/1456
Jordan: ok. That explains missing samples. The forecasting pipeline's smoothing window uses 24h rolling median + sampled tails; missing middle will bias weekly seasonal profile down. We need a quick correction to avoid underprovisioning for the 08:00 load.
Sara: proposing two fixes: (1) replay the missing offsets for 03:00-04:30 and re-run the `daily-forecast-build` job, (2) temporarily widen the smoothing window from 24h->36h so projections don't react to a single ingestion blip. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Liam: replay is safe, and we should re-ingest into the historical raw table. But replay -> double-count risk if dedupe keys aren't precise. Current dedupe uses `(request_id, user_id, minute_bucket)` which should be ok.
Aisha: widening window is a cheap guardrail for the next 24h while we backfill. If we widen, we must annotate the forecast with `ingest_anomaly=true` so ops know it's smoothed.
Jordan: agreed. Action plan: Liam to run replay, Aisha to flip smoothing config, Sara to trigger forecast-run and validate dashboard. Target: complete by 06:30 UTC.
Liam: starting replay now: kafka-consumer-run --group usage-aggregator-v2 --from-offset 120345678 --to-offset 120456999 --topic eu-west-usage. Will stream to staging raw table first.
Sara: config snippet I'll toggle in `forecast-config` (feature flag `smoothing_window_hours`):
```
# forecast-config (k8s configmap)
SmoothingWindowHours: 36
IngestAnomalyTag: "eu-west-2026-03-18-03-ingest-gap"
```
Aisha: I'll add the tag mapping in the dashboard so panels show a red banner when `IngestAnomalyTag` is present.
Jordan: also add a quick regression check: compare `projected_gpu_hours` vs `projected_gpu_hours_smoothed` and raise an alert if delta > 8% for any region.
Liam: replay complete to staging (03:58 UTC). Running dedupe+transform now. ETA ~14min.
ingest-bot: replay task completed, 1.2M msgs reprocessed, 99.997% dedup success.
Sara: kicked off `daily-forecast-build --region eu-west --date 2026-03-18`. Job id 20260318-77.
Aisha: updated Grafana panel annotations and turned on `smoothing_window_hours=36` in staging; will patch prod after validation.
Jordan: nice. After forecast finishes, run the projection QA: compare throughput percentiles (p50/p95) and GPU-hour delta. If delta < 3% we're good; if 3-8% leave `ingest_anomaly=true` and watch for 48h. If >8% we may need emergency burst allocation.
Sara: forecast job finished: p50 delta 2.1%, p95 delta 2.9%, projected additional GPU-hours required for next 24h: +6.5% vs baseline. tagging with `ingest_anomaly=true`.
Liam: will hold off on emergency capacity request. I'll also open a follow-up ticket to investigate schema-registry 503 source with infra.
Jordan: thanks all. Postmortem/notes: replay + smoothing guard avoided a potential underprovisioning event. Follow-ups: (1) infra to fix schema-registry error root cause, (2) add automated replay-on-lag for short gaps, (3) add an annotatable flag in forecast outputs. I'll file the tickets. :thumbsup:
Aisha: created ticket INFRA-3421 (schema-registry 503), INFRA-3422 (auto-replay on consumer lag), FORECAST-121 (ingest anomaly tagging).
Sara: closing the thread — will monitor dashboards for the next 24h. :raised_hands:
